reference.title: Toward an internally consistent pressure scale
reference.source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences

recalculation.notes: No row-wise Pt volumes or numerical sample P-V table are published.

assessment.basis: Every compared free coefficient meets both the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison and parameter-specific numerical similarity screen. Error conventions and fit qualifications remain applicable.

fit.solver_message: Both `ftol` and `xtol` termination conditions are satisfied.

scientific_validation.note: Validated against the free-access publisher article; LitCurate was used only for discovery and enumeration.

primary_source_check.finding: The primary source reports a composition-specific high-spin dolomite-III BM3 with V0 and K0 fitted and K0'=4 fixed, while explicitly warning that V0 is unknown and strongly trades off with K0 and K0'.
primary_source_check.record_note: Coefficients from Discussion paragraph 11, high-spin (larger-volume) branch of Figure 3b. The authors warn that V0 is unknown and trades off strongly with K0 and K0'.

primary_data_check.finding: Seven separable larger-volume markers are bundled. No numerical phase-III P-V table is supplied by the article or auxiliary files.

independent_refit.method: Unweighted diagnostic refits to digitized Figure 3 marker centers with K0'=4 fixed; both pressure and volume objectives are reported because source weights and objective are unavailable.
independent_refit.assessment: The printed curve is consistent with the plotted branch at raster resolution, and the two unconstrained objectives expose the large extrapolation tradeoff described by the authors. These diagnostics validate curve identity but do not reconstruct undocumented source weights.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: Results, paragraphs 8-9; Discussion, paragraphs 10-11; Figure 3; auxiliary Table S1.
parameter_provenance.equation: Discussion paragraph 11 states the phase-III spin branches were fitted with third-order Birch-Murnaghan equations.
parameter_provenance.fit_selection: Figure 3b larger-volume branch. The text says both compression and decompression results were used for high spin, while the plotted larger-volume markers are open decompression symbols; the exact original row mask is therefore not recoverable and is not silently invented.

superseded_record_text.notes: No default_for is assigned because this is a bounded, metastable high-spin reference branch of a high-pressure phase.
validity_notes: Empirical larger-volume spin branch around and below the approximately 47 GPa transition; the endpoints are bounded by the separable Figure 3 markers, not a thermodynamic spin boundary.
V0 is a long metastable extrapolation because dolomite-III was observed only at high pressure.

reference.title: Toward an internally consistent pressure scale
reference.source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences

recalculation.notes: No row-wise Pt volumes or numerical sample P-V table are published.

assessment.basis: Every compared free coefficient meets either the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison or parameter-specific numerical similarity screen; the audit does not classify the complete comparison as parity.

fit.solver_message: Both `ftol` and `xtol` termination conditions are satisfied.

scientific_validation.note: Validated against the free-access publisher article; LitCurate was used only for discovery and enumeration.

primary_source_check.finding: The primary source reports a composition-specific low-spin dolomite-III BM3 with V0 and K0 fitted and K0'=4 fixed and explicitly warns of the high-pressure extrapolation tradeoff.
primary_source_check.record_note: Coefficients from Discussion paragraph 11, low-spin (lower-volume) branch of Figure 3b on compression and decompression. The authors warn of the high-pressure extrapolation tradeoff.

source_locations: Figure 3b, lower-volume compression and decompression branch
primary_data_check.finding: Eighteen separable lower-volume markers are bundled. No numerical phase-III P-V table is supplied by the article or auxiliary files.

independent_refit.method: Unweighted diagnostic refits to digitized Figure 3 marker centers with K0'=4 fixed; both pressure and volume objectives are reported because source weights and objective are unavailable.
independent_refit.assessment: The published curve follows the lower-volume plotted branch within 1.95 A^3, while unconstrained refits move along the severe V0-K0 tradeoff expected from extrapolating a 46-84 GPa dataset to zero pressure. The source coefficients are preserved rather than replaced by a raster-dependent optimum.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: Results, paragraphs 8-9; Discussion, paragraphs 10-11; Figure 3; auxiliary Table S1.
parameter_provenance.equation: Discussion paragraph 11: third-order Birch-Murnaghan equation of state.
parameter_provenance.fit_selection: Figure 3b lower-volume branch on compression and decompression. The source does not publish row identifiers or regression weights, so the bundled marker mask records the visible branch rather than claiming exact recovery of the private input table.

superseded_record_text.notes: No default_for is assigned because this is a bounded, metastable low-spin reference branch of a high-pressure phase.
validity_notes: Empirical lower-volume spin branch around and above the approximately 47 GPa transition; the endpoints are the digitized Figure 3 audit envelope, not a thermodynamic spin boundary.
V0 is a long extrapolation outside the observed stability range and is strongly correlated with K0.
